utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll come by Sunday at the community center and bring whatever tools are needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Rey—your help means a lot. We’ll meet Sunday at the community center, and I’ll have the list of urgent repairs ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that sounds good. Once you send the timing and list, I’ll figure out what I can bring too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll send over the timing and who’s bringing what, and I’ll bring my tools to the repair drive. Then we can see where I can help most.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — that should help me plan. I’ll wait for the timing and list, then I can sort out what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can check the drill battery tonight and let you know. I’m still waiting on the time and the supply list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — please let me know the time tonight, and I’ll keep an eye out for the supply list too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll check the drill battery tonight and send you the time plus any supply list I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s definitely happening, right? Send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on. I’m just pulling the details together and will send them over soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just making sure — you’ll send the details soon, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Uli — I’ll keep it quiet and listen for anything useful about the repair drive. If I hear more, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping it quiet and letting me know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it, Uli — I’ll keep my eyes open and stay quiet. If I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it’s on — go ahead and tell people. I’ll keep you posted as folks reach out and say what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm—you’ll keep me posted as people reach out and say what they can bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — I’ll keep you posted as people reach out and say what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I have the details right before I help—what time is the repair drive, and what still needs to be done?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking on the time, but I do know we need volunteers, tools, and a few spare supplies lined up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — can you let me know the time as soon as you find it? I can help keep track of volunteers and supplies in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll bring my tools by the repair drive and let you know what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates and pass them along if I hear what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll stop by with my tools and tell you as soon as I hear what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren — I’ll wait for the latest tally.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m on it, Mina — I’ll check the numbers and get you the latest tally soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. I’ll wait for the latest tally.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll keep passing that along while I’m out. I’ll let folks know we still need a few more volunteers and some spare tools or supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira—that helps a lot. If you hear anyone with extra hands or supplies, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, so I’ll keep an ear out and send anyone your way who can help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking the location now, Noah — I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m a bit late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We still need to sort the donations and load the last boxes. Start at the porch, then bring them over to the garage.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll start at the porch and move the last boxes to the garage.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning should work if we keep it after the school run. What time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That works for me — how about 9:30 Saturday morning? I’ll bring the drill and screwdrivers unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9:30 works for me—after the school run and before lunch is perfect. Thanks, Gus; I’ll keep it on the calendar.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive details as soon as I have them, and I’m glad you’re coming by to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll come by and help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — Sunday at the community center it is, and I’ll send the full repair drive details soon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — just send it over when Opal confirms, and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll send the location as soon as Opal confirms. Thanks for keeping an eye on donations.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — happy to keep an eye on donations, and I’ll be ready once you send the location.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring a drill, a hammer, and a few screwdrivers. Saturday around 9 should work for me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you stay mostly on quieter tasks Saturday around 9?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, that works for me — I’ll stick to the quieter tasks on Saturday around 9.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll watch for the schedule and be ready right around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll send the schedule and the pickup-time details soon, and we’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out and be ready right around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and help sort things out. What time would you like me to come by?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Sam — Sunday at the community center works just fine; come by around 9 and we’ll get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday around 9 at the community center and help get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’ve got the update now. I can help if I can track down duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, or a few spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — those are the main things I need. If you spot any of them, just bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing, Bo — I’ll keep an eye out for those and bring them by if I find any.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send me the details when you can, and I’ll help sort the sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Leo — I’ll send over the details and the latest sign-up list soon. Thanks again for helping sort everything out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll look out for it and help get the sign-up list sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — let’s start with the biggest repair needs and I’ll note who’s available to help. Also, the drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it — Sunday at the community center works for me. Let’s start with the biggest repair needs and match each one to the right volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — I’ll draft the list of top repair needs and the volunteer matches, then we can fill any gaps together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking the latest location now and I’ll keep track from Maple Street onward.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll spread the word that Maple Street is first and keep folks ready for the next stops.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll note Maple Street as the first stop and keep an eye out for the next locations.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for Pia’s list and send the latest tally once I’ve checked my numbers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — I’m finishing the list now and I’ll send it over soon, with the drop-off details too. I just want to keep the whole thing simple and make sure we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Pia — send it over when it’s ready, and I’ll compare it with my numbers and pass along the tally.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll grab the duct tape and check for the screwdriver and screws. I’ll let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep tracking what’s left for the repair drive. Let me know if you still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll see what I can find and circle back if we’re still short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to help — if anything else comes up, I can jump in late and sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — I think we’re all set for now.
